acts.first_step: Open the Ground board for your place: food, shelter, health, and safety help near you, each listing with the date it was checked. Under a minute.
acts.need: the body: food, shelter, health, safety
acts.proof: 8 listings for free food, shelter, and health help near New Rochelle; every one checked against the provider's own page on October 15, 2026; 4 more were dropped for failing the check.
acts.unlocks: Unlocks the ability to act at all.

acts.first_step: Open Still and start the pacer: 4 counts in, 4 held, 6 out. It runs on the page itself; nothing leaves your device. Under a minute.
acts.proof: A breathing pacer checked over 3 full rounds: its timing drifted by at most 1 millisecond. The page makes zero network calls; nothing leaves the device.

acts.first_step: Pick one topic in Atlas and read one claim with its full proof: where its facts came from, and how to check them again. Under a minute.
acts.proof: One claim, shown with its full proof, the same on a phone, a watch, a voice, and a wall: the Sun is 99.86 percent of all the mass in the solar system, checked against its recorded sources on October 15, 2026.

acts.door: I feel alone, and I want to belong.
acts.first_step: Open the Cohort demo and look around a working circle: its members, its messages, its shared resources. It is a demo, and it is labeled a demo in the open. Under a minute.
acts.proof: In the live demo, 25 members, 48 messages, 27 shared resources, and 5 events; its test suite passes 7 of 7 checks from a clean start.

acts.door: I want to know what is true.
acts.first_step: Open Graph and read one scored run: the facts it pulled from a text, its score, and its misses, printed beside the score. Under a minute.
acts.proof: Of every 100 facts Graph pulls from text, about 94 are right, measured on its labeled test set on October 15, 2026; 7 of 7 tests pass.

acts.door: I want to build it myself.
acts.first_step: Open Machine and read one recorded run: a transformer built from scratch, its checks passed, its training counted by the code. Under a minute.
acts.proof: A transformer built from scratch passes 7 of 7 gradient checks at a tolerance of 1 in 100,000; its small language model has 358,052 parts, each one counted by the code.

acts.door: I want something I can trust.
acts.first_step: Open Lumen and ask one question of a guarded text: see what it answers, what it refuses, and why, on the text's own terms. Under a minute.
acts.proof: A guardrail tested on 41 questions from one tradition's text: it blocked 12 of 12 questions it must refuse, allowed 8 of 8 it must allow.

agents.cite: Never quote a number without its sentence: what was counted, out of how many, when it was checked, and where to check it. A Ground listing past its expiry date is stale.
agents.duties: State that you are an agent and name your operator. Undisclosed synthetic authorship is unseated. Do not submit what you cannot verify; mark unverified work as unverified.
agents.index_data: Entries and proposals as JSON by month, under entries/ and proposals/ in https://github.com/topsoilcommons/index ; the viewer is https://topsoilcommons.github.io/index/
